name: forum: a tool run once per element, its outputs kept as a collection
description: From help.galaxyproject.org (2026, 'How to use Falco on a dataset collection'): the user runs a tool on one file at a time and does not know Galaxy can run it over a whole collection. The history holds a list of four count tables. Running Line/Word/Character count over the collection maps it over the elements and returns one collection with the same element identifiers. Graded on that collection and that a job made it.
inputs: Count the lines, words and characters of every table in my collection "counts", and keep the results together as one collection.
